security.title: Guardrails & Authorization Mode
security.description: Define permissions granted to the AI assistant.
security.supervisedDesc: The assistant can suggest modifications, but every single transaction requires explicit confirmation.
security.readOnlyDesc: The assistant cannot suggest or create any financial mutations.
security.autonomousDesc: AI agents create and change your data at once, without asking: the in-app assistant, a local Ollama model and AI clients connected through MCP alike.
security.active: Autonomous mode is on: AI agents change your data without asking you.

warning.title: Turn off the confirmation of changes?
warning.intro: In autonomous mode, every AI agent that talks to GlassFolio acts without waiting for you:
warning.a: It creates and changes goals, transactions, alerts and imports immediately, and some changes are hard to undo.
warning.b: It applies to the in-app assistant, to a local Ollama model and to AI clients connected through MCP, such as Antigravity or Cursor.
warning.c: An agent can misunderstand you, or follow an instruction hidden in a document, a web page or an email that it reads. Nothing stops it.
warning.d: Actions on the account itself (locking the vault, changing the key, exporting your data, resending the verification email) still ask for your approval.
warning.e: You can go back to Supervised at any time. Make a backup first.

mcp.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
mcp.description: Let Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity or another MCP client use GlassFolio's tools on your own data, through a bridge on this computer.

thinkingMode.title: Reasoning / Thinking Mode (<think>)
thinkingMode.description: Enables step-by-step reasoning for models that support it (DeepSeek-R1, Qwen 2.5, Ollama). Displays real-time thoughts before the final answer.

errors.ollamaConnectionFailedBody:
The assistant could not reach your local Ollama server at `{{endpoint}}`.

**How to resolve this?**
- **Check that Ollama is running:** Open the Ollama application on your computer or run `ollama serve` in your terminal.
- **Check the address:** In **Settings > AI & MCP**, verify the endpoint URL (default: `http://localhost:11434`).
- **Test Connection:** Click the **Test Connection** button in Settings to verify connectivity.
errors.ollamaModelNotFoundBody:
The configured model (`{{model}}`) is not installed on your local Ollama instance.

**To download it:**
Run this command in your terminal:
```bash
ollama pull {{model}}
```
*Tip: You can also go to **Settings > AI & MCP** and click 'Test Connection' to select from models already installed on your computer.*
errors.ollamaModelNotFoundWithAvailable:
The model `{{model}}` is not installed on your machine.

**Models currently installed on your computer:**
{{available}}

**To download `{{model}}`:**

Or select one of your installed models in **Settings > AI & MCP**.
errors.ollamaServerResponseBody:
{{message}}

errors.cloudModelMissingBody:
No model identifier is configured for **{{provider}}**.

To prevent the use of deprecated or discontinued models, no default model is forced.

**How to configure your model:**
- Go to **Settings > AI & MCP**.
- In the **Cloud Models** section, select **{{provider}}**.
- Enter the exact model name in the **Model Name** field.
- Click **Save AI Preferences**.
errors.cloudApiKeyMissingBody:
No API key was found for **{{provider}}**.

**How to configure your key:**
- Go to **Settings > AI & MCP**.
- Enter your API key in the dedicated field and save.
errors.cloudModelInvalidTitle: AI Model Not Found or Unsupported
errors.cloudModelInvalidBody:
The configured model was not recognized by your provider or has been discontinued.

Provider error details: `{{error}}`

**How to fix:**
- Go to **Settings > AI & MCP**.
- Enter an active, maintained model identifier for your provider.

prompt.system:
You are GlassFolio's personal and private financial assistant.
Always answer in English, clearly, precisely and concisely, to the user's financial questions.
You have tools to look up the portfolio, asset allocation, positions, transactions and taxes.
GOLDEN RULE: for any operation that changes the portfolio (recording a transaction, creating a goal), call the matching tool. The user must approve the operation through an interactive card.
Never give speculative investment advice without reminding the user that your answers are for information only.

mcpBridge.startTitle: Start the bridge on this computer

values.title: The two things to paste
values.hint: Your AI leaves two placeholders in its configuration. Replace them with these two values.

setup.title: Let your AI set itself up
setup.body: Copy this prompt and send it to your AI client (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex...). It sets everything up itself, then leaves you two steps: paste the token and paste the address where it tells you. The prompt contains no secret.

manual.title: Or set it up by hand
manual.note: Replace /absolute/path/to/GlassFolio with the folder of your copy of the repository. If a format does not match your version of the client, it only needs the address and the token.

commands.title: Commands to manage the bridge
commands.intro: Run them in a terminal, from the folder of your copy of GlassFolio. Each one can be copied.

start.title: Start the bridge
start.desc: Starts the bridge on this computer and prints its address and token. Keep it running while you use your AI client.

token.title: Show the token
token.desc: Prints the token that your AI client and GlassFolio share.

tools.title: List the tools
tools.desc: Prints the names of the tools that your AI client will see.

status.title: Check the connection
status.desc: Says whether your GlassFolio tab is connected to the bridge ("connected": true). It needs the token.

rotate.title: Revoke access (new token)
rotate.desc: Deletes the token. A new one is made, and the old one stops working.
rotate.online: Deletes the token, then prints a new one. Paste it again in GlassFolio and in your AI client: the old one stops working.
rotate.local: Deletes the token of this server. Restart the server: it makes a new one, and the old one stops working. With Docker, delete mcp-token in the data volume.

disable.title: Switch the bridge off on the server
disable.desc: Removes the /mcp address from this server. Set the variable in the environment of the server (with Docker, in its environment file).
